checkpoint: Cerulean's only way south without Cut (CeruleanCity map.json, scripts.inc) is through the burgled house (30, 11), whose door the policeman leaves once the S.S. TICKET is had, out of the hole in its back wall into the yard (31, 8). The Rocket there (33, 6) stops the player on (33, 5) or (33, 7) (CeruleanCity_EventScript_GruntTrigger*): from (32, 7), the step east onto (33, 7) turns the player to him; Machop and Drowzee, Lv17, then TM28 Dig, and he is gone. Then east round the yard, down to the city's south edge by the path along its east side (39..40, 20..31), down Route 5's east side to the Underground Path's north house (31, 31), through its tunnel and out of the south house onto Route 6, below its door (19, 14).
